obraz: The sheepdog lies where it can see the whole flock
text: The sheepdog lies on the ridge above the flock, head up, watching the whole spread of them. She does not run at every sound, she marks it and stays. Algiz is that wide seeing, the guard kept without the chase. Kuky, something here is worth your watching, and something else is only weather passing over the field.

obraz: The bull tears itself up out of the bog and keeps going
text: At the bog's edge the bull heaves itself free, mud sliding from its shoulders where the wet ground ends and firm earth begins. It does not shake itself clean, Kuky, it walks on with the bog still on its hide. Uruz is strength that comes up out of heavy ground and carries the ground with it. This may be a force in you not yet tested, or one already spent and still moving.
